memory_verse.label: Bible Reference
memory_verse.text: But to the Reubenites, the Gadites and the half-tribe of Manasseh, Joshua said, "Remember the command that Moses the servant of the Lord gave you: 'The Lord your God will give you rest by giving you this land.' Your wives, your children and your livestock may stay in the land that Moses gave you east of the Jordan, but all your fighting men, ready for battle, must cross over ahead of your fellow Israelites. You are to help them until the Lord gives them rest, as he has done for you, and until they too have taken possession of the land the Lord your God is giving them." — Josh 1:12-15 (NIV)

devotion.label: Devotion
devotion.text:
Two and a half tribes had already received their land on the eastern side of the Jordan. They could have said, "We already have ours. Why should we risk our lives fighting for the others?" But God's command through Moses would not allow such thinking. Their fighting men had to cross over and help their brothers until everyone had received their rest.

This is a picture of true family among God's people. We are not saved to look after ourselves alone. When God has blessed us, part of that blessing is the privilege of helping others reach the same rest. Your victory is not the finish line if your brother is still in the struggle.

Notice the recurring word "rest." God's goal for His people was not endless fighting but rest in the land He gave. Yet that earthly rest was only a shadow. The New Testament tells us there remains a greater "Sabbath-rest for the people of God" (Heb 4:9), the rest we enter through faith in Christ, who finished the true battle for us.

Until then, we carry one another. We do not lay down our weapons while a fellow believer is still fighting.

reflection.label: Reflection
reflection.text:
1. Now that God has blessed you in some way, whom is He calling you to help?
2. Are you tempted to stop serving once your own needs are met?
3. How does the "rest" we have in Christ shape the way you help others find it too?

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Father, thank You for the rest You give. Make me willing to stand with my brothers and sisters until they too find rest in You. Amen.
